# 1on1 Marcus - 2026-10-01

**Time:** 60 min, Thursday 11 AM. Walked instead of sitting.
**Person:** [[Marcus Bell]]

## What Marcus brought up

**The postmortem.** Published this morning ([[2026-09-26]]). He wrote it, I reviewed. Clean root cause: a Sidekiq retry config change plus a round-up sweep job with no idempotency key. Every retry re-debited. Devon's reconciliation alert caught it in 47 minutes.

He keeps coming back to one sentence in the doc: "the sweep job was known to be outside the new pipeline." He thinks he should have pushed harder in August to move it. I reminded him we made that call together, knowingly, and wrote it down ([[1on1 Marcus - 2026-08-26]]). The decision was mine as much as his.

**Drop the Pillar weekly sync.** He asked to hand the weekly ops sync with Theresa to Sarah Kim. He was braced for me to say no. Sarah's been sitting in since July, knows the people, and asked for more of it in August ([[1on1 Sarah - 2026-08-05]]).

Decision: Sarah Kim takes over the weekly Pillar ops sync; Marcus stays as escalation.

**NACHA alert tuning.** Still open. The cutoff alert pages too early on slow days and he doesn't trust it, so he checks manually, which defeats the point. Wants until Oct 13.

## What I brought up

**Him.** Not the work. He took three days off in September, not the week we agreed. Since August: cut-over, KYC close-out, the Pillar sync, and now an incident at 10 AM on a Saturday. He said "I'm fine" three times. I said I didn't believe him. He laughed, which was the first real thing he said all hour.

Risk: Marcus burns out before the VP Eng starts, and we lose the one person who holds the whole payments system in his head.

**What the VP Eng changes.** Incident process, on-call health and the cross-team routing move to the VP Eng. He keeps architecture and the parts he loves. He asked whether that's a demotion. No. It's the opposite: it's protecting the part of his job that only he can do.

**Comp.** Post-close, he's first in line. Said it again; it's in writing in May.

## Commitments

- [ ] Marcus: NACHA-cutoff alert tuning by 2026-10-13
- [ ] Marcus: idempotency keys on all money-moving jobs by 2026-10-23
- [x] Marcus: idempotency ADR proposal (posted Oct 5)
- [ ] Me: tell Theresa that Sarah takes over the weekly ops sync by 2026-10-16
- Marcus: one full week off after GA. Booked, not "planned."

## Read on Marcus

Running on fumes and duty. He's still excellent, which is the problem: nothing in his output tells you he's empty. Only the tone does.

## Personal note

I keep saying "post-close" to the people I most need to keep. It's become my version of "after Series B" for my own life. See [[Stop Being the Router]].

Related: [[ACH Pipeline]], [[VP Eng Search]].
